resources.string: It lets you browse and install free creations — addons, maps, textures and skins — for Minecraft.
Do I need an internet connection?
Yes, to browse and download. Once a file is saved you can install it offline.
How do I install a creation?
Open a creation, tap Get files, download the file, then tap Install — Minecraft opens and imports it automatically.
Make sure Minecraft is installed and updated, then try installing the file again.
Some files are hosted on servers that are slow in certain regions. Turning on a VPN often helps.
I installed it but can\'t find it in game.
Enable the pack in your world settings, and turn on any experimental toggles the creation requires.
Heavy addons need more resources. Lower your render distance or remove other packs.
Ads keep the app and all creations completely free.
Yes — every creation in the catalog is free to download and install.
How often is new content added?
The catalog is updated regularly with new creations.
Are the files safe for my worlds?
Creations are packaged in Minecraft\'s own formats. Back up important worlds before adding big addons.
